mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month (as measured by the change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.5%, it indicates a highly accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (<=0.5%) and stable consumer price index (monthly CPI change <= 0.2%) indicates a monetary policy stance that is accommodative without inflationary pressure, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During the early business cycle expansion phase (as indicated by housing starts above 1700 thousand units), strong consumer confidence and economic growth support equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances during the early expansion phase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate over the past month (as measured by the change in UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining UNRATE are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017=100), it indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and falling housing starts (HOUST < 1700) signals a deepening economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (as indicated by CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.5%), the central bank is likely to tighten policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances during high inflation periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
